stories.title: AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Target Indian Financial Infrastructure
stories.summary: India's cybersecurity agency warned that threat actors are deploying artificial intelligence tools against communication and technology infrastructure across the country. These attacks have breached internal systems and triggered unauthorized payment transactions across multiple banks, fintech firms, and service providers.
stories.why_it_matters: The incident illustrates the operational shift toward automated, AI-assisted exploitation aimed directly at core financial transaction networks.

stories.title: Data Theft Discovered Across AI Inference Providers via Zero Data Retention Bypass
stories.summary: Security researchers discovered that attackers maintained unauthorized access inside three commercial AI inference hosts for several months without detection. The breach exfiltrated confidential prompts, including sensitive user requests explicitly tagged with Zero Data Retention security flags.
stories.why_it_matters: This breach exposes critical architectural risks in third-party inference routing and undermines contractual privacy assurances in enterprise AI pipelines.

stories.title: Ghostscript Vulnerability Enables Sandbox Escape and Remote Code Execution
stories.summary: Researchers published an exploit detailing a sandbox escape in Ghostscript triggered by malformed file uploads to web applications. Because numerous Linux servers rely on Ghostscript for background document processing, arbitrary malicious files can achieve remote command execution.
stories.why_it_matters: Ghostscript's ubiquitous deployment in automated server-side file pipelines makes document-processing sandbox escapes an acute risk for enterprise infrastructure.

stories.title: Critical GPGME Library Flaw Exposes Applications via Malicious OpenPGP Keys
stories.summary: The GnuPG project disclosed a critical memory-handling vulnerability in GPGME triggered when parsing OpenPGP keys containing oversized user identifiers. Attackers can supply specially crafted public keys to compromise dependent applications and exfiltrate private data.
stories.why_it_matters: Because GPGME is the standard cryptographic interface for countless enterprise utilities, memory flaws in the library threaten foundational software verification and encryption systems.

stories.title: CISA Issues Warning Over Active Exploitation of Critical Cisco Expressway Flaw
stories.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency warned that threat actors are actively exploiting a critical remote code execution flaw in Cisco Expressway systems. Federal agencies were directed to remediate the vulnerability immediately to prevent perimeter compromise.
stories.why_it_matters: Edge communication and gateway appliances represent primary targets for initial enterprise access, making active exploitation of Cisco infrastructure an immediate threat.

stories.title: GL.iNet Cloud Platform Vulnerability Exploited to Compromise Hardware Devices
stories.summary: Hardware vendor GL.iNet confirmed that attackers leveraged an exploit in its cloud management system to compromise networked routers and KVM hardware. The intrusion resulted in rogue backdoors and reverse shells being installed across customer edge equipment worldwide.
stories.why_it_matters: Cloud-based centralized device orchestration platforms present single-point-of-failure risks that can transform vendor access into widespread hardware backdoors.

stories.title: Cleverbridge Payment Platform Data Breach Exposes Customer Credit Card Details
stories.summary: E-commerce billing platform Cleverbridge disclosed that an unauthorized intrusion compromised customers' full financial transaction data. Stolen information included payment card numbers along with CVV security verification codes.
stories.why_it_matters: Direct exfiltration of unencrypted card and verification numbers highlights severe compliance and cryptographic isolation failures within central payment processors.

stories.title: State Hackers Use Cairn AI Security Tool to Uncover Zero-Day Flaw
stories.summary: Amazon researchers reported that a China-aligned advanced persistent threat actor leveraged the open-source autonomous penetration testing framework Cairn against educational targets. Analysis indicates the automated tooling successfully discovered an unknown zero-day vulnerability during live intrusions.
stories.why_it_matters: The deployment of autonomous AI penetration tools by state actors accelerates the weaponization and real-time discovery of zero-day vulnerabilities in targeted networks.

stories.title: National Security Agency Recovers From Widespread Internal Network Outages
stories.summary: The National Security Agency returned to baseline operations following severe disruptions that affected its internal classified and administrative networks. Operational centers had temporarily instituted localized Code Orange protocols and delayed facility access for non-essential staff.
stories.why_it_matters: Prolonged network disruption inside premier intelligence entities indicates acute internal architecture vulnerabilities or unprecedented lateral disruption.

stories.title: Congressional Scrutiny Threatens Military Contracts Over Starshield Configuration Changes
stories.summary: Congressional leaders initiated an inquiry into SpaceX following unauthorized operational adjustments to Starshield satellite constellations deployed in Ukraine. Lawmakers warned that unilateral network policy modifications could forfeit future satellite defense contracts.
stories.why_it_matters: The dispute highlights critical operational frictions when military command structures depend on commercial space and satellite telecommunications architectures.

stories.title: Atlanta Air Traffic Paralyzed by Delta Flight Management System Failure
stories.summary: A critical failure in the automated system responsible for aircraft weight and balance calculations halted Delta flight departures at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport. The outage triggered widespread nationwide cascading delays across the commercial aviation network.
stories.why_it_matters: Core dispatch and load balancing software represent single points of failure that can completely disable real-time global transport operations when resilience mechanisms fail.

stories.title: BepiColombo Spacecraft Reaches Mercury to Begin Joint Scientific Mission
stories.summary: The joint European and Japanese BepiColombo mission successfully entered Mercury's planetary orbit following an eight-year interplanetary cruise. The spacecraft has separated into two dedicated orbiters equipped to map the planet's magnetosphere, geology, and core composition.
stories.why_it_matters: Data collected by the dual orbiters will resolve fundamental questions regarding the formation and structural evolution of rocky planets close to parent stars.
